decisions.reason: As a very recent launch that builds on the firm’s established automation business and fits its announced push toward smarter automation, management would be inclined to continue backing it rather than reverse course after investing in development and market introduction.

Because this dual-table loading system extends the core offer, supports customers’ productivity needs, and has only just been launched in a growing and investment-heavy phase, management would likely justify staying committed to it.

Even though it is more distant from the core offer, the firm has given it visible public commitment through a dedicated webpage and an advertised Red Dot award, which under escalation of commitment makes management likely to persist and attribute any early uncertainty to the normal ramp-up of a new product.
